title: 10029 - Consultant - Analista de Qualidade Pleno - Home Office
description:
A Provider IT é uma consultoria de tecnologia com foco no ser humano, que desde 1996 está no mercado transformando negócios e envolvendo nossos colaboradores na criação de um futuro mais humano e positivo.
Há mais de duas décadas, estamos comprometidos em facilitar futuros, acreditando que a tecnologia é capaz de acelerar novas realidades. Em 2023, fomos reconhecidos pela revista Exame como uma das empresas que mais cresceram no Brasil. Além disso, temos uma equipe que realiza um recrutamento ético, reconhecida e premiada pelo LinkedIn, recebendo o prêmio Best Talent Acquisition Team.
Estamos liderando a digitalização de grandes corporações, comprometidos com a sustentabilidade e explorando o poder da Inteligência Artificial para impulsionar o crescimento e evolução dos negócios e das pessoas. Aqui você será desafiado e irá desenvolver suas competências em um ambiente acolhedor e de muita inovação.
Venha Fazer Parte De Um Time Que Impulsiona a Próxima Geração De Soluções Tecnológicas, Confira Esta Vaga
Analista de Qualidade Pleno
Buscamos um QA Pleno com experiência consistente em automação de testes, capaz de elevar nosso nível de qualidade e ajudar a transformar um ciclo que hoje é majoritariamente manual em um processo moderno, confiável e escalável.
Responsabilidades
O QA será responsável por planejar, criar e executar cenários de testes funcionais e automatizados para aplicações web, integrações e fluxos críticos do projeto Omni. Também irá atuar na construção e evolução de nossos frameworks de automação, garantindo cobertura adequada dos principais fluxos de negócio e contribuindo para a redução de retrabalho, incidentes e gargalos.
A rotina inclui análise de requisitos, participação ativa nas cerimônias com os times de produto e engenharia, identificação de riscos e desenho de estratégias de testes que equilibrem profundidade, velocidade e impacto. Esperamos que essa pessoa ajude a disseminar boas práticas, colabore na estruturação de pipelines de qualidade e contribua diretamente para aumentar a maturidade do time.
Requisitos
Buscamos alguém com experiência sólida em testes automatizados para aplicações web, utilizando ferramentas como Cypress, Playwright, Selenium ou equivalentes. É importante ter domínio de criação de scripts, organização de suítes e boas práticas de manutenção de testes.
Conhecimento de testes de API, uso de Postman ou frameworks de automação focados em serviços, além de experiência em pipelines de CI CD, é essencial. Também buscamos familiaridade com análise de logs, entendimento do fluxo entre sistemas e capacidade de escrita clara de cenários e documentação.
Experiência prévia com metodologias ágeis, entendimento de arquitetura web e habilidade de trabalhar de forma próxima ao time de desenvolvimento são fundamentais.
Diferenciais
Vivência com cenários de omnicanalidade, integração entre canais de venda e fluxos de pedidos em varejo digital. Experiência em testes de integração em ambientes distribuídos, uso de mocks e testes orientados a contrato. Conhecimento em testes de performance e estabilidade também será valorizado.
Nosso compromisso é oferecer oportunidades justas e imparciais. Celebramos a diversidade, a equidade e a inclusão. Na Provider IT todos são bem-vindos, independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, característica física, idade ou afins.

title: Vendedor - LIGAÇÃO - Trabalhe de casa
description:
Vaga de Vendedor - LIGAÇÃO - Trabalhe de casa em Rio de Janeiro. R$ 1.500,00 a R$ 3.500,00 (Bruto mensal). Período Integral. Autônomo Área e especialização profissional: Comercial, Vendas - Atendimento Nível hierárquico: Operacional Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro, RJ Regime de contratação de tipo Autônomo Jornada Período Integral Estamos selecionando vendedores(as) por ligação para integrar um time enxuto, estruturado e orientado a performance, atuando em modelo home office, diretamente com leads quentes (clientes que já demonstraram interesse pelo produto).
Esta vaga é EXCLUSIVAMENTE para vendas por ligação.
Não se trata de atendimento por WhatsApp. O WhatsApp é apenas a porta de entrada do lead. O fechamento acontece por telefone, com ligação imediata assim que o cliente demonstra interesse.
O profissional será responsável por ligar para todos os clientes interessados, conduzir a conversa com clareza, esclarecer dúvidas, gerar confiança e realizar o fechamento da venda. Não há prospecção fria. Os leads chegam prontos, e o diferencial da operação está na agilidade e qualidade da ligação.
A atuação ocorre principalmente em horário comercial, das 8h às 17h, em regime home office, exigindo disponibilidade integral e atenção constante aos atendimentos. No entanto, chegam leads também fora desse horário, e atuar nesses momentos é um grande diferencial competitivo, pois quanto mais leads atendidos e mais vendas realizadas, maior é o ganho financeiro. Profissionais focados costumam aproveitar esses atendimentos extras justamente para aumentar significativamente a própria renda.
Os leads devem ser ligados no momento em que entram, sem atrasos. Esta não é uma vaga compatível com outro trabalho simultâneo e não se trata de renda extra. É uma oportunidade para quem busca renda principal, com potencial de ganho elevado.
O trabalho é realizado com nutracêuticos voltados à saúde, especificamente produtos que auxiliam com sintomas relacionados à próstata aumentada. O profissional deve ter maturidade, postura profissional e ausência de constrangimento para falar sobre o tema de forma clara, ética e responsável. Todo o treinamento técnico e comercial será fornecido.
Esta é uma vaga 100% comissionada, sem salário fixo. O modelo de ganho é meritocrático, com comissão escalonada, onde quanto maior o desempenho em vendas por ligação, maior o ganho financeiro. A operação possui alta demanda e clientes interessados diariamente, o que gera potencial real de ganhos elevados para quem executa bem.
Buscamos pessoas com experiência prévia em vendas, preferencialmente vendas por ligação, sendo considerado um diferencial importante já ter atuado em call center, lidando com alto volume de ligações e metas. É essencial ter resiliência emocional, foco em resultados e capacidade de manter ritmo intenso de chamadas.
Não é uma vaga para quem procura estabilidade, renda complementar ou rotina previsível. É indicada para profissionais que querem fazer das vendas por ligação sua atividade principal, em modelo home office, com foco em resultado, consistência e crescimento financeiro.

title: Designer – Branding Focus for Marketing Team
description:
About Lumenalta
At Lumenalta, we create impactful software solutions that drive innovation and transform businesses. Since 2000, we've partnered with visionary leaders to build cutting-edge technology, solve complex challenges, and deliver faster results through our elite teams and tech-driven approach. Join us in shaping the future of technology.
Your Role
As a Designer focused on Branding & Visual Strategy, you will play a pivotal role in shaping our marketing efforts through compelling and cohesive design strategies. Your primary goal will be to align business objectives with user-centered design principles, creating impactful visual assets, motion graphics, and experiences that resonate with our audience and elevate engagement.
Responsibilities
Collaborate with the marketing team to define business goals and translate them into innovative and strategic branding solutions.
Develop and maintain brand guidelines to ensure consistency across all visual, digital, and motion touchpoints.
Design assets for web, mobile, and other marketing channels, leveraging tools like Figma to create wireframes, prototypes, and final designs.
Create motion graphics and video content to enhance storytelling and brand communication.
Conduct user research and gather feedback to refine designs, ensuring alignment with end-user expectations and business objectives.
Formulate and drive the internal visual design strategy to ensure excellence and cohesion across all creative outputs.
Handle complex use cases involving large-scale audiences and multiple interdependencies.
Iterate designs based on data insights, feedback, and emerging trends to enhance brand visibility and user engagement.
Your Team
You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product owners, and marketers. This role requires the ability to:
Act as a bridge between business goals and design execution.
Quickly understand and translate abstract concepts into tangible designs.
Independently manage branding projects while collaborating with team members to meet deadlines and objectives.
Requirements
7+ years of professional experience with a portfolio showcasing branding expertise, visual strategy, motion graphics, and versatility across mediums.
Senior-level experience: At least 4 years of experience designing digital products, marketing campaigns, and video content across web, mobile, and other platforms.
Proven track record of delivering pixel-perfect end-to-end designs, including motion graphics and video editing, that align with brand strategy.
Strong understanding of large-scale branding projects, including complex use cases involving millions of users or substantial financial impact.
Proficiency in design tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, and motion/video editing tools like After Effects or Premiere Pro.
Superior English fluency, both verbal and written.
Key traits: Professionalism, problem-solving ability, proactiveness, attention to detail, and a passion for visual storytelling.
Preferred Skills
Ability to identify and set trends in visual design to maintain brand relevance and impact.
Experience working with data-driven design processes and conducting user research.
Familiarity with agile methodologies and collaborating in fast-paced environments.
Strong communication skills to present and justify design decisions effectively.
This is a unique opportunity to leave a lasting impact on our branding efforts and contribute to meaningful, large-scale projects. If you're a designer with a passion for Branding and a proven ability to deliver exceptional results, we'd love to hear from you
This is a fully remote position; however, candidates must be based in Latin America (LATAM) to ensure effective collaboration with the team's schedule.
Start Date: Immediate. Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and the posting will remain open until November 28.

title: Product Designer II, Grocery
description:
About The Role
We're looking for a product designer to join the Merchant Success team for Grocery & Retail at Uber Eats. As part of this team, you'll play a key role in building trust with merchants through new capabilities like reporting and insights, disbursements, invoicing, and more to help them run their business successfully.
At Uber, Product Designers tackle challenges and work on big new ideas that will transform how people use our products. In a rapidly growing environment, you'll collaborate with engineers, product managers, content designers and some of the world's best designers and researchers. Uber Design makes magic by crafting and shipping delightful experiences for people around the globe.
What The Candidate Will Need / Bonus Points
---- What the Candidate Will Do ----
Onboard to the Uber Design team: Learn how we collaborate and use design tools, how to design with the Uber Base design system, and how we design for clarity, inclusion, accessibility, scalability, and global localization.
Onboard to your product area: Meet your cross-functional stakeholders, learn about their business goals and strategy, get familiar with existing tech platforms, and understand your team's product development and launch review process.
Scope: Work on projects of all sizes, from problems that are well-known to those more complex and conceptual, while leading a roadmap in your product area.
Process: Build a deep understanding of the users you are designing for through data and research, lead the end-to-end design process, solicit and incorporate feedback from experts, translate your designs to build with engineers, and work flexibly with a variety of teams. Design at all levels of fidelity, thoroughly explore the problem space, and practice good judgment on making tradeoffs.
Craft: Turn big ideas into simple, elegant products. Ship features that are effective and easy to use. Deliver designs that are innovative and scalable. Document design frameworks such that others can build upon your solutions. Have a strong understanding of business, data, and engineering requirements, and create experiences that deliver real customer value.
Efficiency: Prioritize and manage your time efficiently, operate with high autonomy, manage several concurrent projects at once, and collaborate effectively.
Communication: Communicate with clarity and persuasiveness, and effectively present your work and rationale to all the relevant stakeholders. Proactively communicate with your team and manager, facilitate design sessions, and collaborate with other designers. Maintain honest and trusting relationships with your team.
Influence: Lead team activities through ideas, organization, and execution. Supports internal initiatives to improve the Design team. Share your skills and learnings with other team members.

3+ years of Product Design experience
Experience building products for mobile apps, tablets, and web interfaces
A portfolio showing your high-quality, thoughtful UI and UX work
Fluent/Advanced English skills
Preferred Qualifications
Proficiency with Figma or similar tools and prototyping methods
Experience working with user experience researchers and various methods of research
Experience working and collaborating in a tech environment
Shipped many successful software products, ideally both mobile and desktop
Highly proficient in storytelling and prototyping
Ability to strongly articulate your design work and rationale to your peers and cross-functional team
Experience designing with large-scale design systems and frameworks

title: Accreditation Client Group Manager
description:
Department: Tournament and Venue Operations
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
The Accreditation Client Group Manager plays a key role in the operational delivery of client group accreditation services in support of tournament operations across all venues and official facilities.
Reporting to the Accreditation Client Group Senior Manager, the Accreditation Client Group Manager is responsible for the day-to-day coordination, and delivery of accreditation services for assigned client groups for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027.
Working within the established tournament accreditation framework, and in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich Accreditation, FIFA27 Accreditation teams and functional areas, the role ensures that client group accreditation requirements are delivered in line with defined FIFA accreditation policies, access control protocols, and agreed service standards.
The role provides operational leadership to Client Group Coordinators and serves as the primary operational escalation point for assigned client groups.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Client Group Management:
Act as the primary accreditation point of contact for assigned client groups (e.g. safety & security, workforce, volunteers, suppliers, commercial partners).
Understand and manage client group accreditation requirements, volumes, timelines, and access needs in line with the overall accreditation framework and agreed milestones.
Coordinate the delivery of client group accreditation activities across all planning and operational phases.
Monitor readiness and proactively identify delivery risks, escalating issues as required.
Accreditation Process Delivery:
Manage the end‑to‑end accreditation process for assigned client groups, including data collection, validation, access rights assignment, badge production, and distribution.
Ensure accurate application of access rights in accordance with approved zoning concepts, access matrices, and security requirements.
Coordinate accreditation activities and dependencies with Accreditation Operations, Systems, Security, and Venue teams.
Track application progress, volumes, and bottlenecks and implement corrective actions where required.
Team Leadership & Support:
Lead, coordinate, and support Client Group Coordinators in the delivery of day‑to‑day accreditation activities.
Provide guidance on complex cases and ensure consistent application of processes across client groups.
Support onboarding, training, and knowledge sharing within the client group team.
Promote clear task ownership, prioritisation, and accountability.
Stakeholder Engagement & Communication:
Work closely with FIFA and FIFA27 functional areas to support agreed accreditation requirements and timelines.
Communicate accreditation procedures, deadlines, and data requirements clearly and consistently to client groups.
Support the preparation and delivery of training sessions, briefings, and guidance materials.
Act as the primary operational escalation point for client group accreditation issues, escalating complex or cross‑functional matters to the Client Group Senior Manager.
Event-Time Operations:
Support the operation of Accreditation Centres and badge distribution points before and during the tournament.
Coordinate with Venue Operations, Security, and Accreditation Operations teams to resolve access‑related issues quickly and effectively.
Provide operational decision‑making support within defined authority during peak arrival and match‑day phases.
Support on‑site supervision of accreditation staff and workflows as required
Reporting, Compliance & Continuous Improvement:
Ensure all client group accreditation activities comply with FIFA accreditation regulations, data protection requirements, and security protocols.
Maintain accurate client group accreditation records, statistics, and issue logs.
Provide regular operational updates and reports to the Client Group Senior Manager.
Contribute to post‑event reporting, lessons learned, and knowledge transfer activities.
YOUR PROFILE
University degree or equivalent higher education in Event Management, Sports Administration, Operations, or a related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in accreditation, access management, client services, or operations within major international events.
Strong working knowledge of accreditation systems, access control concepts, and venue zoning models.
Experience working in large‑scale, multi‑stakeholder, and multicultural event environments.
Strong organisational and coordination skills with a high level of attention to detail.
Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in high‑pressure environments.
Clear and confident communicator with strong stakeholder management skills.
Ability to identify issues early and escalate appropriately.
Team‑oriented mindset with a strong focus on delivery and compliance.
Flexibility to work extended hours during peak tournament phases.
Right to work in Brazil.
Fluent in English (spoken and written)
Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Por isso, desenvolvemos os melhores cuidados e experiências de forma ética, sustentável e acessível da fórmula às embalagens. Nossas marcas destinadas ao varejo são Dabelle e Eico.
Nosso time está espalhado por todo o país e atualmente temos a sede no Rio, além de escritórios em São Paulo e Recife. SOBRE NÓS
Fundado por portugueses nos anos 50 com o nome "Casas Guanabara", o pequeno comércio se transformou no Supermercados Guanabara, uma das mais tradicionais e modernas redes do país. Atualmente possui 28 lojas distribuídas no Rio, Grande Rio, Baixada Fluminense e Região Metropolitana, dois centros de distribuição e dois depósitos.
Para garantir a melhor experiência de compras para os seus clientes, prezando pelo conforto e segurança, as unidades contam com piso antiderrapante, rampas de acesso para facilitar a circulação, corredores amplos, grande quantidade de check-outs, estacionamento inteligente, além de um mix diferenciado para atender a qualquer orçamento.
E não para por aí
A rede de Supermercados Guanabara seguindo a tendência mundial do setor supermercadista implantou nas lojas a captação da água da chuva e do sistema de ar-condicionado, com reúso nos banheiros e lavagem das lojas. A iluminação tem a tecnologia led e um projeto arquitetônico que inclui fachada de vidro para evitar o desperdício de energia.
Você sabia que a rede inovou e levou o shopping para dentro do supermercado? Atualmente várias unidades Guanabara possui centro comercial com lojas de serviço e grandes magazines. Algumas lojas operam com sistema store in store, orientação de sommelier na hora da escolha de vinhos.
O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara
A rede já foi eleita pela revista Veja Rio como "A marca mais amada do Rio" e por 14 anos pela pesquisa "Marcas dos Cariocas", em parceria com O Globo, a "Marca preferida dos Cariocas".
E você sabe qual o segredo de todo esse sucesso? São os 11 mil talentos que compõem esse time campeão.

title: Senior Manager, Hospitality Stakeholder Services
description:
Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue
Location: Brazil
Description
FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women's sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.
Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.
THE POSITION
Sitting within the Ticketing & Hospitality Department, Hospitality (along with Ticketing) aims to deliver the most engaging, and innovative Women's World Cup experience for all partners, customers, guests and the FIFA football family.
Reporting organizationally to the Head of FWWC27 Hospitality Operations, the Senior Manager Hospitality Stakeholder Services will help serve Hospitality efforts for the FIFA Women's World Cup 2027 that is hosting 32 teams across 8 venues.
This role will be responsible for the overall management of hospitality stakeholder servicing across the 8 host cities, ensuring an exceptional and consistent guest experience to FIFA's Affiliates and their guests throughout the tournament.
Further, this role will oversee a wide range of responsibilities, including the operational management and delivery of the Affiliates Hospitality Programme in accordance with contractual obligations, as well as ensuring the servicing of key stakeholders (such as FIFA's Commercial Partners, Licensees and Media Partners), in close collaboration with FIFA HQ, FIFA's Official Hospitality Provider, the stadium authorities and other relevant stakeholders, ensuring a consistently high-quality and professional delivery.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Oversee, in close collaboration with FIFA Zurich, the execution of the Affiliates hospitality programme across all stadiums of the FIFA Women's World Cup 27
In close collaboration with FIFA Zurich, plan and execute FIFA Affiliates' hospitality activations, ensuring their requirements are met and delivering on sponsorship and other contractual obligations.
Monitor and ensure FIFA's Affiliates contractual rights are delivered and observed across the implementation of the entire FIFA Hospitality Programme.
In close collaboration with FIFA Zurich and the Official Hospitality Provider, ensures contractual hospitality allocation planning, delivery, and fulfilment.
Ensures operational readiness & delivery of the FIFA Affiliates Hospitality programme, across all venues, validating maps & plans, drawings, staffing plans and coordinating all operational communication with FIFA's Affiliates and their agencies.
Manage the FIFA Hospitality Stakeholder Team responsible for the on-the ground execution of the FIFA Affiliates Hospitality Programme across all venues.
Develop and implement comprehensive affiliates hospitality venue operations plans and strategies that align with the tournament's objectives and deliver exceptional guest experiences.
Ensure effective coordination and collaboration with and between stakeholders, including FIFA, the Official Hospitality Provider, FIFA's Affiliates, and other relevant parties.
Manage cross-divisional communication and service level agreements for the implementation of on-site affiliates hospitality requirements and services, ensuring deliveries to the highest standards and in respect to contractual obligations.
Prepare and present comprehensive reports on FIFA Affiliates hospitality operations, including performance metrics and recommendations for future events.
Organize and attends FIFA Affiliates' Hospitality-specific site visits and workshops.
Coordinate Affiliates branding permits and approvals.
Responsible for hospitality parking allocation, requests, and fulfilment for FIFA's Affiliates.
Monitors and ensures the implementation of clean site obligations in Hospitality areas in close collaboration with FIFA's rights delivery team and the Official Hospitality Provider.
Prepares end of tournament reports on the FIFA Affiliates Hospitality Programme.
YOUR PROFILE
Bachelor's Degree or similar level of education in Hospitality Management, Events Project Management, Marketing, etc.
Minimum of 8 years of work experience in hospitality and/or sponsorship management, preferably for major sports events.
Proven experience in managing multiple stakeholders, events, and venues simultaneously.
Proven experience with event hospitality and ticketing
Ability to lead, manage, and motivate a team
Proven project management experience
International business profile is a must
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong customer-service attitude, even when under pressure.

O desafio
A GuidelineIT está crescendo e buscamos alguém para assumir a fila de suporte com padrão, organização e responsabilidade. Você vai atuar majoritariamente no atendimento remoto e no escritório, com visitas pontuais a clientes (1–2x/semana) para resolver demandas presenciais ou apoiar projetos.
A missão é simples e rara no mercado: resolver bem, registrar bem e reduzir escaladas, liberando o time sênior para projetos, automação e melhorias.
Responsabilidades
Atender e resolver chamados (incidentes e solicitações) via Service Desk, WhatsApp, telefone e suporte remoto.
Conduzir o ticket do início ao fim: diagnóstico, solução, validação com o usuário e fechamento com registro claro.
Suporte em Microsoft 365 (admin básico/intermediário): usuários, licenças, grupos, Teams, OneDrive/SharePoint (permissões e sincronização), práticas básicas de segurança (MFA e afins).
Troubleshooting em Windows 10/11, instalação/configuração de aplicativos, ajustes e resolução de problemas recorrentes.
Noções de rede para troubleshooting: IP, DNS, DHCP, Wi-Fi, conectividade, impressoras/periféricos.
Diagnóstico de hardware em notebooks/desktops (disco, memória, bateria, superaquecimento, fonte, tela) e definição de ação: ajuste, troca simples, garantia/RMA ou fornecedor.
Quando aplicável, realizar trocas simples (SSD/RAM/bateria) e preparação de equipamentos para onboarding (instalação, drivers, padronização).
Criar e atualizar base de conhecimento (KB) e procedimentos, reduzindo retrabalho e aumentando qualidade do atendimento.
Visitas presenciais em cliente 1–2x/semana para demandas pontuais e apoio a projetos.
IA faz parte do nosso jeito de trabalhar
A GuidelineIT opera com cultura de processo e velocidade. IA é uma ferramenta oficial para ganhar eficiência (documentação, diagnóstico, automações simples e melhoria contínua).
Esperamos curiosidade, autonomia e capacidade de usar IA de forma responsável: fazer perguntas boas, validar respostas e transformar isso em entrega com qualidade.
Responsabilidade e segurança (obrigatório):
É obrigatório seguir boas práticas e não compartilhar dados sensíveis de clientes (credenciais, dados pessoais, prints com informações confidenciais) em ferramentas públicas.
Requisitos obrigatórios
Experiência com suporte N1/N2 (help desk/service desk) e rotina de ferramenta de chamados.
Boa base em Windows e troubleshooting.
Conhecimento prático de Microsoft 365 (admin no mínimo básico).
Capacidade de diagnosticar problemas de hardware em notebooks e orientar a melhor ação (troca, garantia/RMA, fornecedor).
Boa comunicação, organização e disciplina para documentação.
Disponibilidade para deslocamentos pontuais dentro do RJ (1–2x/semana).
Diferenciais (valorizados)
Certificações Microsoft: MS-900, SC-900, MD-102, MS-102 (ou equivalentes).
Experiência com Intune/Entra ID, backup, antivírus/EDR, RMM.
ITIL (conceitos) e organização de processo.
PowerShell básico para rotinas simples.
Experiência prática usando IA (ChatGPT/Copilot) para acelerar troubleshooting, documentação e automações simples, com validação técnica.
Domínio e pratica com ferramentas de RMM & DeskManager

Esse time é um dos motores cruciais para o nosso foguete voar cada vez mais alto Por isso, é movido à muita energia para bater as metas, disciplina para cumprir o combinado e resiliência para transformar os desafios em oportunidades
Os tripulantes do Comercial são muito unidos, possuem uma disposição ímpar e para fazer parte desse time você precisa saber tudo sobre a Beep - afinal, esses Beepers conversam diretamente com as empresas, clínicas, escolas e outros negócios parceiros ... Ah Não basta saber vender, é preciso encantar e respeitar sempre a regra mais importante desse jogo: ser ético
Comunicação, proatividade, determinação, domínio dos negócios da empresa, paixão por gente… estas são apenas algumas características fundamentais para quem quer embarcar nessa viagem. Se identificou? Só vem
Responsibilities and assignments
Sua Missão Será
Identificar e prospectar novas oportunidades de negócios encontrando empresas que possam se beneficiar dos nossos produtos ou serviços e criar estratégias para abordá-las de forma eficaz.
Manter e expandir relacionamentos com clientes existentes, garantindo a satisfação e buscando oportunidades para vendas adicionais ou cruzadas.
Negociar termos e condições com clientes e fechar contratos que atendam às nossas necessidades e dos nossos clientes, sempre buscando o melhor resultado para ambas as partes.
Monitorar tendências do mercado e da concorrência para ajustar estratégias de vendas e identificar novas oportunidades.
Monitorar o progresso das vendas e preparar relatórios sobre desempenho, metas e estratégias para a liderança.
Trabalhar em conjunto com outras áreas da empresa, como branding e operações, atendimento ao cliente e logística, para garantir que as soluções oferecidas ao cliente sejam entregues conforme o prometido.
Alcançar ou superar metas de vendas estabelecidas pela liderança, contribuindo para o crescimento e sucesso geral da empresa.
Organizar e executar ações comerciais internas e externas, para ativação de empresas e parceiros em eventos e feiras.
Fornecer suporte às parcerias iniciadas na região para garantia de performance.
Cumprir e garantir a execução dos atendimentos, sempre zelando pela cultura Beep.
Requirements And Qualifications
Para embarcar nesse desafio e se tornar um Beeper, você precisa ter:
3 a 5 anos de experiência anterior na área comercial B2B.
Ensino superior completo.
Desejável conhecimento em técnicas de negociação e venda, Excell e Salesforce.
Foco no cliente interno e externo, relacionamento interpessoal, resiliência, conhecimento técnico, gestão de resultados, gestão da mudança e gestão de pessoas.
Additional information
Benefícios Para Os Beepers
Para sua saúde e de seus dependentes – Plano de Saúde e Odontológico | Sulamérica;
Benefício Farmácia: até 40% de desconto em medicamentos;
Pacote de alimentação: VA/VR/Lanche todos os dias/Estações para um pit stop durante o dia;
Pensando na sua saúde física e mental: GymPass / Total Pass /Seguro de Vida
Para seu desenvolvimento: descontos em instituições de ensino parceiras;
Vale transporte;

A maior empresa de saúde domiciliar do Brasil e, todos os dias, levamos tecnologia e carinho humano para as pessoas.
Desde 2016, cumprimos o nosso propósito de levar as melhores experiências em serviços de saúde para todo o Brasil, simplificando os cuidados e sendo referência em atendimento. Com a Beep você agenda seus exames e vacinas de forma rápida e prática pelo aplicativo e no dia e horário marcado nossa equipe vai até você.
A Beep já encantou mais de 2 milhões lares, um marco que reflete a confiança de milhares de clientes e o nosso compromisso em ser referência em serviços de saúde para a família brasileira.

Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno

Esse profissional realizará avaliações independentes dos controles implementados pela 1ª linha, garantindo aderência às políticas internas, normas regulatórias e melhores práticas de mercado.
Também será responsável por acompanhar indicadores de risco, revisar vulnerabilidades e incidentes, apoiar a atualização de políticas e normas e participar dos processos de gestão de terceiros e avaliações de riscos em novos projetos e produtos.
O profissional deverá ter perfil analítico, comunicação clara e habilidade para traduzir temas técnicos para públicos diversos, atuando de forma colaborativa com áreas de tecnologia, riscos, auditoria e negócios.

Realizar assessments independentes de controles cibernéticos, validando entendimento e informações fornecidas pela 1ª linha de defesa
Atuar como 2ª linha de defesa, realizando supervisão, governança e reporte dos riscos cibernéticos.
Conduzir avaliação e validação de riscos de segurança, assegurando aderência às políticas, normas internas e requisitos regulatórios.
Apoiar a definição, revisão e monitoramento do Framework de Segurança da Informação e Cibernético (políticas, normas, controles).
Acompanhar controles cibernéticos implementados pela 1ª linha e indicar gaps, desvios e ações de remediação.
Elaborar e manter indicadores, dashboards, KRIs e KPIs de risco cibernético.Atuar no processo de gestão de riscos corporativos, conduzindo análises (qualitativas e quantitativas) de ameaças, vulnerabilidades e impactos.
Participar de avaliações de terceiros (TPRM) e análises de risco em novos projetos, produtos e integrações.
Realizar análises de incidentes sob a ótica de risco e garantir registro, classificação e lições aprendidas.
Suportar processos de conformidade com LGPD, controles de privacidade e governança de dados.
Apoiar na elaboração relatórios executivos para comitês, diretoria e áreas de auditoria/riscos.

Formação superior completa ou em andamento em TI ou áreas correlatas.
Fundamentos sólidos de Segurança da Informação, riscos cibernéticos e principais frameworks (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS).
Experiência em gestão de riscos, incluindo avaliação, classificação e tratamento de riscos cibernéticos.
Conhecimento de controles de segurança (IAM, MFA, antivírus/EDR, patch management, hardening, logging, backup, segregação de redes).
Experiência com políticas, normas e processos de SI.
Noções de arquitetura de segurança e infraestrutura (AD, redes, cloud, endpoints).
Conhecimento de princípios de LGPD e boas práticas de privacidade.
Capacidade de interpretar relatórios técnicos (vulnerabilidades, SOC, incidentes) e traduzir para risco.
Familiaridade com riscos de terceiros (TPRM).
Conhecimentos de continuidade de negócios e PCN/DR.
Experiência prévia com 2ª linha de defesa ou funções de governança de SI.
Certificações como ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, Security+, Cyber Security Foundation, LGPD Foundation.
Conhecimento sobre regulamentações do setor financeiro/seguros (SUSEP, BACEN, CVM, etc.).

A SANDECH possui um Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (SGQ) bastante maduro, sendo certificada internacionalmente pela ABS na ISO 9001:2015. Além da aprovação da certificadora (ABS Quality Evaluations), nosso SGQ foi auditado por cinco de nossos Clientes e aprovado para execução de projetos de engenharia críticos, incluindo a realização de atividades offshore com risco de parada de produção.
Por que se inscrever no nosso Banco de Talentos?

Desenvolvimento Profissional Contínuo: Aqui, valorizamos o aprendizado constante. Oferecemos um ambiente que estimula o crescimento técnico e comportamental, com possibilidades reais de evolução profissional.
Excelência Reconhecida: Faça parte de uma empresa certificada pela ISO 9001:2015, reconhecida pela qualidade de seus processos, gestão eficiente e atuação em projetos de alta complexidade.
Cultura Colaborativa: Trabalhe ao lado de profissionais qualificados, em um ambiente colaborativo, ético e orientado a resultados, onde o trabalho em equipe faz a diferença.

description:

Projetar e implementar arquitetura de segurança, promovendo as melhores práticas e definindo controles de segurança de forma a proteger os dados e sistemas contra ameaças cibernéticas. Realizar avaliações de risco, desenvolvendo políticas de segurança, identificando e priorizando vulnerabilidades e falhas de controles, propondo correções, mitigações e mantendo-se atualizado sobre as últimas ameaças e tendências de segurança para fortalecer continuamente a postura de Segurança da Informação.

Análise dos ambientes corporativo, nuvem, automação industrial e automação predial para propor e definir arquiteturas e controles de proteção.
Elaboração de políticas e arquiteturas focadas em segurança cibernética.
Especificações técnicas de soluções e procedimentos.
Identificação de lacunas e propostas de melhorias em políticas e arquitetura de segurança.
Análise de novas tecnologias para elevar a maturidade de segurança.
Avaliações de boas práticas e benchmarkings comparando com empresas e institutos de pesquisa.
Relatórios e apresentações de Segurança da Informação para diversas soluções.
Pesquisas e provas de conceito em Segurança da Informação.

Recomendações e revisões de configurações e arquitetura de segurança.

Avaliação da qualidade do filtro de e-mails para ajuste de falsos positivos/negativos.
Suporte e melhorias nos processos de gestão de vulnerabilidades e aplicação de patches e baseline de segurança.
Verificação do escopo dos controles e suporte na definição de estratégias de aprimoramento.
Análise de vulnerabilidades em ativos corporativos e revisão de planos de remediação.
Colaboração com outras equipes para remoção de entraves e automação de tarefas.
Colaboração e participação com outras equipes para implantação de soluções tecnológicas.
Arquitetura de conformidade e gerenciamento de riscos, recomendando controles e ações corretivas.
Monitoramento e gestão de exposição e análise de critérios para tratamento e priorização de vulnerabilidades.
Acompanhamento e reporte de resultados das atividades de gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades e aplicação de patches.
Arquitetura de análise de dados de vulnerabilidades e aplicação de patches para identificação de anomalias.
Arquitetura de gestão de postura de Segurança da Informação, incluindo baseline de redes, endpoints, servidores, e nuvem.
ArquIIetura de gerenciamento de incidentes de segurança, incluindo a identificação, resposta, mitigação e documentação de incidentes para minimizar impactos e prevenir recorrências.
Arquitetura de perícia digital.
Arquitetura de Inteligência contra ameaças, monitorando e analisando ameaças emergentes para antecipar e mitigar riscos, além de fornecer insights para fortalecer a postura de segurança.
Realização de viagens para avaliação de eficácia de controles in loco.

title: Instrument Technician
description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore's True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.
About Us:
SBM Offshore is the world's deepwater ocean-infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. It starts with Advancing our Core: continuing to advance the decarbonization of traditional energy production. While Pioneering More: helping to enable the energy transition and using our unique capabilities in ocean infrastructure to support more industries to grow sustainably. Sharing our experience for a better blue tomorrow.
Reports To
Instrument Supervisor
Background
The Technician is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
The technician/operator will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.
Authority
The Instrument Technician is authorized to maintain Instrument assets and systems safely.
Immediate Subordinates
Subcontractors, Visitors, Vendor Representatives
Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards
Dismantle and Reassemble Instrumentation Equipment
1.1 Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.
1.2 Use correct procedures and correct method of dismantling.
1.3 Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.
1.4 Identify, check and prepare components.
1.5 Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
Monitor and Maintain the Condition of Instrumentation Equipment
2.1 Adjust instruments to meet the operating specification.
2.2 Adjust with minimum disruption to any ongoing activities and minimum waste of resources.
2.3 Monitor and record what has been carried out in work history or log.
Diagnose Faults in Equipment.
3.1 Respond promptly to problems in line with approved procedures.
3.2 Select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures and apply them methodically.
3.3 Carry out Visual, Close and Detailed inspections on 'Ex' equipment.
3.4 Use the results of inspections to determine the appropriate actions to take.
3.5 Record an accurate and full description in the appropriate document history.
Monitor and Maintain Pollution Control Measures.
4.1 Unplanned discharges to the environment are identified, halted where possible, and reported according to policy, procedure and regulation.
4.2 Relevant PPE is used to deal with unplanned discharges using company procedures.
4.3 Equipment, waste or other materials for disposal are dealt with according to the correct procedure.
4.4 Environmental protection and pollution control are enforced effectively with colleagues, subordinates and subcontractors.
Emergency Response
5.1 Carry Out Emergency Response role (See Station Bill).
5.2 Demonstrate competence in Emergency Response drills and exercises.
Recruitment Only-Generic Functional Competencies
Offshore - Demonstrate an Understanding of PandIds
Offshore - Handover
Offshore - Diagnosis and Fault Finding
Offshore - Reports
Offshore - Computerised Maintenance Management System
Offshore - Planning Work
Offshore - Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment
Offshore - Hazardous Area Classification
Offshore - Safety Management
Pre-hire Qualifications And Experience
Proven experience and/or qualified to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Instrument Engineering or local equivalent.
Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
Good experience of Permit to Work, Instrument/Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
COMP ex E'X' course preferred.
Medically fit according to The Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.
GENERAL INFORMATION
SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. Com sede em Copenhague, Dinamarca, a Pandora fabrica suas deslumbrantes joias em três instalações de artesanato na Tailândia, onde mestres artesãos dedicam-se a criar cada peça com perfeição, se destacando como a maior joalheria do mundo, famosa por seus icônicos braceletes e charms que permitem que você conte sua própria história. Além disso, suas coleções incluem anéis, brincos e colares, todos com designs exclusivos e elaborados à mão, utilizando apenas materiais de altíssima qualidade.
Inovadora e Sustentável
A Pandora é pioneira no setor, sendo a primeira joalheria do mundo a utilizar produtos 100% reciclados. Com um compromisso firme com a sustentabilidade, cada peça não é apenas uma joia, mas uma celebração do estilo e da consciência ambiental.
Na PANDORA, somos guiados por quatro valores:
We Dream (Sonhamos), somos visionários e vamos além do óbvio. We Dare (Ousamos) perseguir ambições ousadas com coragem e rapidez. We Care (Cuidamos) nós nos preocupamos profundamente uns com os outros, com nossos clientes e com o planeta que todos compartilhamos. Todos os dias nos esforçamos para ser um local de trabalho gratificante, onde cada um de nós pode prosperar e contribuir, onde os talentos podem crescer e cumprimos nossas promessas a colegas, clientes, parceiros e partes interessadas - We Deliver (entregamos).
Somos todos embaixadores de nossa marca e, juntos, formamos a comunidade Pandora.

Realizar o atendimento personalizado aos clientes da marca;
Atendimento ao cliente na pós-venda;
Criar uma base de clientes fidelizados;
Gestão e organização de estoque, operação do sistema, devoluções e trocas;
Abastecer a loja e repor peças quando não estão disponíveis na seção;
Manter a organização, montagem e limpeza da vitrine;
Participar dos treinamentos internos, sobre os produtos de luxo feito à mão para se tornar um especialista em produtos PANDORA;
Seguir as diretrizes da empresa, cumprindo todas as políticas e procedimentos, a fim de manter o padrão internacional de nossas lojas;

title: Process Eng.
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Overview:
We are seeking a Process Engineer with extensive hands-on expertise in Utilities processes to join our Operation Engineering Solutions Department (OESD) under Global Manufacturing (GM) Excellence Organization.
OESD's technical team is responsible for providing high-quality, multi-disciplinary support to GM operating facilities (Refineries, NGLF, and petrochemical plants) within the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and globally.
Your primary is to provide in-depth process engineering and operations expertise to monitor, optimize, and drive performance improvement programs for Utilities, including both remote and on-site technical advisory support and benchmarking of utilities.
Key Responsibilities:
As successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:
Conduct regular performance reviews of existing Utilities through key performance indicators (KPIs) representing optimum operability, profitability, reliability, and process safety.
Develop and present quarterly benchmarking reports with actionable improvement recommendations.
Provide hands-on support in implementing performance improvement initiatives, demonstrating measurable results in closing identified gaps from quarterly benchmarking reports.
Lead benchmarking and best practices exchange workshops among Global Manufacturing facilities (wholly-owned and affiliates) and facilitate knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.
Deliver on-demand remote and field technical advisory support, including process design, troubleshooting, start-up/shutdown activities, and capacity test runs.
Provide detailed service reports for each support activity, highlighting facility needs, actions taken, results, and lessons learned.
Collaborate with Global Manufacturing facilities engineers to identify and implement cost optimization or process improvement initiatives, focusing on "low-hanging fruits" that require minimal capital investment, through operational adjustment or design modification.
Conduct internal assessments on Utilities using Saudi Aramco engineering standard references and highlight any deviations or better standards applied by affiliates for endorsement to facility management or Saudi Aramco Central Engineering.
Act as the overall coordinator for cascading and driving Global Manufacturing and Corporate programs for Utilities in operating facilities, enabling their execution and effective monitoring.
Participate in Business Plan development, coordinate with stakeholders for capital investments on assigned Utilities and support techno-economic evaluations.
Evaluate and recommend new Utilities technologies, coordinate with Central Engineering to facilitate field deployment.
Minimum Requirements:
You will hold a Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering or related specialization. An advanced degree is preferred.
You will have a minimum of 15 years of total Utilities unit experience (process engineering and operations) with at least 10 years of hands-on experience in handling refinery's utilities.
You will have experience in water desalination and boilers for steam generation
You will be able to optimize various utility systems, with specific examples of performance improvements achieved.
You will have in-depth knowledge of major equipment suppliers and package units for Utilities.
You will have a proven track record of conducting technical troubleshooting, start-up, shutdown, and capacity test runs for utility systems.
You will have strong proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools specific to Utilities performance metrics.
You will also have strong management and coordination skills, with experience in stakeholder management.
Working environment:
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

description:
Venha ser #EASY
Prazer, somos a Easy Live — e nossa missão é simples e poderosa: transformar Fidelidade em Felicidade.
Somos um Hub de Entretenimento que conecta os usuários dos maiores Programas de Fidelidade, Clube de Benefícios, Incentivos e Vantagens do Brasil aos melhores eventos do país, além de serviços e produtos que tornam experiências incríveis mais acessíveis. title: Senior Project Controls Specialist
description:
Job Description
Job Overview:
The Senior Project Controls Specialist uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the project controls discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the project controls discipline. The Senior Project Controls Specialist solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Project Controls Specialist impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the project controls team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.
Responsibilities
Key Tasks and Responsibilities:
Lead the development and deployment of advanced visual analytics to support project performance monitoring, forecasting, and executive-level reporting
Apply data mining, statistical modeling, and trend analysis techniques to identify key performance indicators, cost drivers, and schedule risks across complex, multi-phase projects
Integrate and link data from multiple internal and external sources to build robust, multi-dimensional models that support real-time decision-making
Architect scalable data structures and implement standardized methods for data transformation, validation, and automation across project controls systems
Collaborate with cross-functional teams—including engineering, procurement, construction, finance, and IT—to understand business needs and translate them into actionable data solutions
Interpret complex data requests and deliver clear, accurate, and insightful outputs that align with project and organizational objectives
Provide strategic insights by identifying correlations, anomalies, and emerging trends within large datasets to support proactive project management
Guide and mentor junior team members on data governance, reporting standards, and best practices for data management, storage, and security
Develop predictive models and forecasting tools based on historical data, current trends, and scenario planning to support long-term project planning and risk mitigation
Support the implementation and continuous improvement of digital project controls tools and platforms, ensuring alignment with global EPC standards and practices
Lead or contribute to the development of internal training materials and knowledge-sharing initiatives to elevate data literacy and project controls capabilities across the organization
Ensure compliance with internal controls, client requirements, and industry standards in all aspects of data handling and reporting.
Act as a subject matter expert in project data analytics, guiding Project Managers, Cost Engineers, and Executive Stakeholders on data-driven decision-making
Qualifications
Essential Qualifications and Education:
Bachelor's Degree in Business, Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management or a related field
Minimum of five (5) years of relevant experience in Project Controls, Cost Engineering, or Financial Analysis within an EPC or project-driven environment
Proficiency in general office productivity tools, particularly spreadsheets, word processing, and presentation software
Strong understanding of project controls principles, including cost control, scheduling, forecasting, and performance measurement
Demonstrated ability to work independently while also leading collaborative efforts across global, multidisciplinary teams
Strong critical thinking, problem-solving, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment
Fluent in English with excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and engage stakeholders at all levels
About Us
Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we've forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.
For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.

academias, identificando e avaliando novos mercados e potenciais franqueados. Este profissional
coordena todas as etapas do processo de expansão, desde a negociação inicial até o suporte na
implementação e abertura da nova unidade, assegurando a conformidade com os padrões e a cultura
da marca.
Principais Responsabilidades:
Planejamento Estratégico: Desenvolver e implementar o plano estratégico de expansão da rede
de academias, definindo metas de crescimento e áreas prioritárias.
Prospecção e Qualificação: Realizar a prospecção ativa de potenciais franqueados, agendar e
conduzir reuniões comerciais e avaliar o perfil dos candidatos (perfil "closer" focado em
fechamento de negócios).
Análise de Mercado e Localização: Identificar e negociar pontos comerciais estratégicos,
realizando estudos de viabilidade de mercado e análise da concorrência para novas unidades.
Gestão de Contratos e Negociação: Conduzir processos de negociação, elaborar e gerenciar
contratos de franquia, garantindo a conformidade legal e os melhores termos para a franqueadora.
Suporte à Implementação: Coordenar e apoiar todas as etapas de implantação da nova unidade,
desde o projeto arquitetônico até a fase pré-operacional, garantindo a padronização da marca.
Relacionamento com Franqueados: Atuar como ponto focal entre a franqueadora e os novos
franqueados, oferecendo suporte contínuo, orientações sobre políticas e procedimentos, e
auxiliando na resolução de problemas iniciais.
Qualificações e Habilidades:
Experiência Comprovada: Experiência sólida e comprovada em expansão de redes de franquias
ou no mercado fitness/varejo.
Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo em Administração, Engenharia Civil, Arquitetura ou
Engenharia de produção, Gestão Comercial, Economia ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou
especialização em Franquias ou Gestão de Negócios é um diferencial.
Habilidades de Negociação: Excelente capacidade de negociação e persuasão, com foco em
resultados e fechamento de negócios.
Visão Estratégica: Capacidade de análise de mercado, visão estratégica e habilidade na resolução
de problemas.
Comunicação e Relacionamento: Ótima comunicação oral e escrita, além de habilidades
interpessoais para se relacionar com diferentes níveis hierárquicos e perfis de franqueados.
Ferramentas e Softwares: Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em pacote Office (Excel,
PowerPoint, Word) e, preferencialmente, em ferramentas de gestão e Power BI

description:
This job is with ABB, an inclusive employer and a member of myGwork – the largest global platform for the LGBTQ+ business community. Please do not contact the recruiter directly.
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we'll give you what you need to make it happen. It won't always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you'll never run alone. Run what runs the world.
This Position Reports To
Business Manager - Commercial&Portfolio
Role Mission
Are you passionate about solutions for the energy, marine, and offshore segments and want to be part of a global company that is transforming the industry with cutting-edge technology? ABB is looking for a Service Sales Manager to join our Marine & Ports Division team in Brazil. If you have experience in sales and services in the segments mentioned above, team leadership, and contract negotiation, and are ready to take on major challenges, this opportunity is for you
Responsibilities
Ensure the execution of the sales strategy for the entire Marine & Ports Division portfolio in Brazil through planning, leadership, and development of the sales team.
Create, plan, and implement sales strategies and initiatives for business development, aligned with the global strategy.
Set sales targets and monitor their achievement, defining and implementing improvement plans.
Identify opportunities with new, existing, and potential customers within the country, adjusting the sales plan and resource allocation when necessary.
Develop strong relationships with key customers, decision-makers, as well as associations and representative entities in the marine and offshore segments, ensuring efficient communication and customer satisfaction.
Participate in negotiations of service contracts with strategic customers and ensure previously established margins.
Lead and develop the sales team, maintaining a healthy, organized environment with qualified and focused professionals.
Requirements
Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Naval Engineering, or Automation (highly desirable).
Proven experience in sales and services, preferably in the energy, marine, and offshore segments.
Solid experience in leadership and people management, with availability for frequent travel.
Proven track record of closing deals and negotiating service contracts.
Fluent English for conversation and writing is mandatory.
Must reside in Rio de Janeiro, Niterói, or Macaé.
Active Category B driver's license is required.
Differentials
Knowledge of ship electrical systems (generation, distribution, and propulsion) and digital services.
What We Offer
Be part of a global company involved in high-impact projects in the marine and port sectors.
A collaborative environment with continuous learning, access to training, and advanced technologies.
Career development opportunities in a solid technical and commercial path, with growth potential within the organization.
About ABB Marine & Ports Division
ABB Marine & Ports is a global leader in electrical, digital, and automated solutions for vessels and port infrastructure. With a robust portfolio that includes electric propulsion systems, energy management, and digital services, we deliver solutions that increase efficiency, reduce emissions, and drive sustainable transformation in the marine industry

title: moço de convés
description:
Sobre a OceanPact
A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar.
Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.
Sobre a vaga
Estamos em busca de um Moço de Convés experiente e motivado para atuar em nossa área da Navegação, que compartilhe dos nossos valores contribuindo com exercicio de suas funções com segurança. Essa posição é estratégica para garantir excelência operacional em nossa frota, buscando obter os melhores resultados.
Responsabilidades
Comprometimento com o Sistema de Gestão Integrado da Empresa, incluindo padrões de SMS e segurança de processo atender às manobras da embarcação, ocupando os postos para os quais tenha sido escalado.
Ajudar na execução das manobras de fundeio, suspender, atracar, desatracar, entrada e saída de diques e quaisquer outras fainas.
Receber, no convés da embarcação, e transportar para os paióis respectivos o material de custeio pertencente à seção de convés.
Operar os aparelhos de manobra e peso, nas fainas da embarcação (acionar guinchos, suspender e arriar paus de carga, guindastes, preparar cábreas, acunhar e desacunhar escotilhas, colocar dalas, rateiras, defensas e balões no costado, luz de bulbo, cabo de segurança de proa e popa) ou onde se fizer necessário.
Executar os serviços necessários a conservação, tratamento, limpeza e pintura da embarcação, dos paióis (paiol da amarra, conveses, costado, escotilhas, amuradas, escadas, varandas, passarelas, superestruturas, mastros, guindastes, cábreas, gigantes, turcos, tetos, anteparas, balsas, berços, baleeiras, extratores de ar, ventiladores de gola) e dos demais compartimentos de sua responsabilidade.
Executar todas as tarefas determinadas pelo Contramestre da embarcação, tais como limpeza, tratamento, pintura, lubrificação e quaisquer outras rotinas de manutenção do material de convés
Requisitos
Obrigatórios:
TBS-1/EBCP/CIR/STCW/Febre Amarela dentro da validade
Categoria maritima Moço de Convés
Demonstrar disciplina, pontualidade e responsabilidade profissional;
Capacidade de seguir cadeias de comando e manter uma postura ética e proativa.
Desejáveis:
Experiência prévia em apoio maritimo
Local de trabalho
Embarcado
O que buscamos
Queremos pessoas que se identifiquem com os nossos valores:
Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade
O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência
Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento
Confiança: relações transparentes e comprometidas
Inovação: melhoria contínua e novas ideias
Resultados: foco em entregas com valor
O que oferecemos
Pacote de remuneração compatível com o mercado, com salário fixo e benefícios competitivos
Plano de saúde e odontológico, para você e sua família, porque cuidar de quem cuida importa
Vale-refeição e/ou alimentação, além de vale-transporte (ou auxílio mobilidade, conforme o modelo de trabalho)

title: Linux Desktop
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1100+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
This is an opportunity for an Linux Engineer/Administrator with a passion for Linux and Customer Success to build a career with Canonical and support the technical needs of customers leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have a passion for technology and an eagerness to learn, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
You will be accountable for delivering an outstanding technical support experience on the full Desktop and Server technical stack at Canonical. From problem qualification to full resolution, you will own and manage your cases. When needed, you will transfer your cases to your colleagues or involve senior engineers.
Your day to day job is to provide technical expertise, be an excellent communicator and a service-oriented professional. Every day you will have to make judgement calls to prioritise customer issues and maximise your effectiveness. You will also need to set time aside to learn about our new products and technologies and evolve as a professional. You will participate in various training sessions, team gatherings and Company events.
Location: This is a globally remote role, unless specified otherwise.
The role entails
Investigate issues reported by customers by researching and escalating issues
Work to resolve complex customer problems related to Canonical's portfolio of products.
Ownership of results: Ensure that each support case owned by you is handled according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA) with the highest possible customer satisfaction by setting the right expectations and fulfilling your commitments.
Engage directly with customers and work collaboratively by phone, ticketing system, and remote sessions to resolve their issues.
Participate in a regular weekend working rotation.
Contribute new knowledge base articles and maintain existing articles, ensuring shared knowledge and lessons learned are available to customers.
Understanding Ubuntu development process to be able to set customer expectations correctly on timeline for a fix.
What are we looking for in you
Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills
Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
Experience with Linux troubleshooting (collecting logs and stack traces, fine-tuning by editing configuration files)
Experience with Linux integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.)
Troubleshooting experience:
Linux integration with other environments (authentication/directory services, network file systems, etc.).
Ability to navigate effectively stack traces and logs, and advise on next steps.
Solid understanding of OS and Application level bugs and when to escalate to the correct team.
Ability to learn quickly, thrive on change and handle the pressure of a customer facing job
Programming fundamentals in any language.
Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
Extensive Customer support experience is key:
Customer needs are top priority.
Communicate professionally, emphatically, clearly and set the right expectations.
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
Annual compensation review
Recognition rewards
Annual holiday leave
Maternity and paternity leave
Employee Assistance Programme
Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Lidar com comportamentos compulsivos;
Estimular as atividades recreativas (caminhadas, leitura, jogos e etc.);

title: Interconnection Sales Specialist
description:
Who are we?
Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You'll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You'll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you're empowered to do your best work.
Who are we?
Equinix is the world's digital infrastructure company, operating over 260 data centers across the globe. Digital leaders harness Equinix's trusted platform to bring together and interconnect foundational infrastructure at software speed. Equinix enables organizations to access all the right places, partners and possibilities to scale with agility, speed the launch of digital services, deliver world-class experiences and multiply their value, while supporting their sustainability goals.
A career at Equinix means you will collaborate on work that impacts the world and be surrounded by endless opportunities to learn new skills and grow in varied directions. We embrace diversity in thought and contribution and are committed to providing an equitable work environment that is foundational to our core values as a company and is vital to our success.
Job Summary
The Interconnection Sales Specialist (ICSS) is responsible for driving digital revenue growth by accelerating Fabric, Fabric Cloud Router and Network Edge, and platform adoption across new and existing accounts. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, including Sales Account Executives, Solution Architects and Technical Account Managers to deliver the full value of Equinix's digital services portfolio.
Responsibilities:
Product Solutions Expertise
Be a digital product and services expert. Sharing your knowledge of industry best practices, our digital service product offerings, and their benefits to customers.
Support building digital expertise and new products growth across field sales. Partner with Sales Account Executives on digital customer fit, pitch, personas, uses cases, common pain points, potential competitors, and how to handle objections.
Actively maintain and grow your expertise in leading transformational technology concepts and methodologies
Build Customer Relationships
Work as a business partner with account teams to develop digital pursuit strategies with customers and partners.
Build relationships with key stakeholders in assigned accounts, prospects, and partners.
Contribute to quarterly business reviews with customers to identify and develop new digital selling opportunities.
Territory and Account Planning
Drive digital prospecting and account growth within existing accounts or new logos with Sales Account Executive.
Partner with Account Executives to identify, qualify, prioritize, and execute digital services strategies for short and long-term pursuit to achieve assigned sales objectives
Analyze customer data and make recommendations on how to maximize the digital services solutions within assigned territory or account segmentation
Product Solution Selling
Work with Account Executives to identify customers' business needs, challenges and technical requirements and matches to Equinix solutions.
Work closely with Solutions Architects to perform presales feasibility assessments to ensure that digital solutions meet the customer requirements.
Define value metrics within the prospects/customers and deliver value assessments
Engage and influence key decision makers within client base.
Facilitate resources necessary to further sales cycle such as Solution Architects, Technical Account Managers, Product, Customer Success, Marketing etc.
Meet or exceed Monthly, Quarterly and Annual sales objectives and revenue quota, constantly working towards team, monthly & quarterly KPI metrics such as pipeline build, revenue attainment, digital bookings and opportunities development.
Pipeline Management
Prioritize list of accounts/prospects for short and long-term pursuit to achieve assigned sales objectives
Provide timely and accurate information to management such as forecasting and opportunity status
Work with Marketing, Channel and Business Development to support the creation and running of campaigns to generate additional pipeline
Negotiation
Works with Sales Account Executive to drive quoting, negotiating, and closing of digital services sales
Support the Account Executive with digital services contracts and serve as a liaison to the legal team.
Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor's degree in business, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
Language: Advanced/fluent English
Experience: Solid experience in selling enterprise and cloud solutions; selling infrastructure-as-a-service; technical sales and account management
Strong Knowledge of business challenges facing enterprise executives that are driving digital transformation use case adoption
Skills And Attributes
Passionate about infrastructure, interconnection, and the future of technology and software-as-a-service
Digitally savvy and strong sales management background
Excellent relationship building skills with demonstrated ability to build meaningful relationships with Equinix customers, prospects, and internal colleagues
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to work collaboratively in cross-functional teams
